table.name: TLGNS_SAP_BP
table.description: Contains SAP Business Partners. Can either be a soldto (customer), billto, shipto or a combination of billto and shipto. The table contains attributes which are only set for Shipto, but as SAP does not distinguish this, Logon also keeps all in one table. Additional Logon-only attributes are contained in extension tables, see tlgnc_shipto. In special cases Logon writes data into the tlgns_sap_... tables as well, e.g. for 'dummy customers', when the BP are not or not yet contained in SAP.

column.name: SAP_BP_ID
column.description: PK. Given by the Logon system.

column.name: SAP_ID
column.description: The (trimmed) ID used by SAP system. Received via the SAP interface, leading zeros are trimmed. This is a kind of foreign key into SAP (KNA1_KUNNR, trimmed).

column.name: SAP_IFC_ID
column.description: The ID used by SAP system, exactly as received and also used for sending to other systems, i.e. including the leading zeros. Received via the SAP interface. (LIFNR, original).

column.name: UPDATE_BLOCKED_BY_HJID
column.description: Contains the hjid of the notification that blocks any further updates if this is the case or 'null' if not blocked. Non-enforced FK to ULGNSAP.BPN_BUSINESSPARTNERNOTIFICAT_0.

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Deletion code in SAP (KNA1_LOEVM). 0=active, 1=deleted. Note that Logon normally has active_flag, with inversed logic. We stick to SAP standards in the tlgns_sap_... tables.

column.name: NAME1
column.description: Last Name/Company Name 1 from SAP (KNA_NAME1)

column.name: NAME2
column.description: First Name/Company Name 2 from SAP (KNA_NAME2)

column.name: CONTACT_NAME
column.description: Goods recipient master_customer_master_contact_person's NAMEV + ' ' + NAME1 from SAP

column.name: CONTACT_PHONE
column.description: Goods recipient master_customer_master_contact_person's TELF1 from SAP

column.name: COUNTRY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_country_bs. Country from SAP (KNA1_COUNTRY).

column.name: POSTAL_CODE
column.description: Zip Code/Postal Code from SAP (KNA1_PSTLZ)

column.name: CITY
column.description: City from SAP (KNA1_ORT01)

column.name: REGION
column.description: Region (Canton in CH) from SAP (KNA1_REGION)

column.name: STREET
column.description: Street from SAP (KNA1_STRAS)

column.name: HOUSE_NUMBER
column.description: House number from SAP (ADRC-HOUSE_NUM1)

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_lang_bs. Language from SAP (KNA1_SPRAS_ISO). 'Z1' from SAP is mapped to 'de'.

column.name: SAP_LANGUAGE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_language_bs. Language from SAP (KNA1_SPRAS_ISO). This value will be used to define the initial value for lang_cd. Also used when identifying TLGNS_SAP_MAT_PLANT_NORM entries for Logo printing during delivery note generation.

column.name: CUSTOMER_CLASSIFICATION
column.description: Customer Classification from SAP (KNA1-KUKLA)

column.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_account_group_bs. Account group from SAP (KNA1-KTOKD)

column.name: RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. The (optional) railway station of the shipto. Most shiptos do not have a railway station. Value is mapped by a lookup with values LAND_SBBT and KNA1_BAHNS from SAP in TLGNC_RAILWAY_STATION, UIC_COUNTRY_CD and RAILWAY_STATION_NO.

column.name: BP_IS_SHIPTO
column.description: Technical flag for easier filtering; is set if this BP has a Partner Function to itself with Function=Ship-to (WE).

column.name: BP_IS_SOLDTO
column.description: Technical flag for easier filtering; is set if this BP has a Partner Function to itself with Function=Sold-to (AG).

column.name: BP_IS_BILLTO
column.description: Technical flag for easier filtering; is set if this BP has a Partner Function to itself with Function=Bill-To (RE).

column.name: BP_IS_PAYER
column.description: Technical flag for easier filtering; is set if this BP has a Partner Function to itself with Function=Payer.

column.name: BP_IS_DRIVER
column.description: Technical flag. Set in SAP import to true in case the BP is received with 'Z015' in field master_customer_basic_data / KTOKD.

column.name: CENTRAL_POSTING_BLOCK
column.description: Indicates whether the customer is blocked for FI postings in all company codes. Posting (FInance), is a standard accounting function to create business transactions in the general ledger. Logon will block all contracts related to the company codes of the BP.(SAP: master_customer_basic_data.SPERR, mapped)

column.name: CENTRAL_DELIVERY_BLOCK
column.description: Indicates whether the customer is blocked for deliveries creation in all sales areas. Logon will block all contracts related to the sales areas of the BP.(SAP: master_customer_basic_data.LIFSD, mapped)

column.name: CENTRAL_ORDER_BLOCK
column.description: Indicates whether the customer is blocked for deliveries creation in all sales areas. Logon will block all contracts related to the sales areas of the BP. (SAP: master_customer_basic_data.AUFSD, mapped)

column.name: TREAT_AS_ONETIME_FLAG
column.description: Technical flag. Set in SAP import to true in case the BP is received with 'Z011' (one time customer) or 'Z004' (one time shipto) in field master_customer_basic_data / KTOKD.

column.name: CHROMAT_REDUCTION_MONTHS
column.description: Chromat reduction in months as received by SAP sales area information master_customer_basic_data / KATR1. Certain countries (e.g. NGE) do not maintain this field. Logon sets -1 if nothing received from SAP (null for other BP types ok). Business Background: cement leads to allergic reactions for certain persons, which can be prevented by adding some reduction material into the cement. This number influences what materials can be delivered to a customer, or how a material has to be mixed with reduction material ('Zudosierung' when loading) so that the material is non-allergic for so many months. Typical value is 2 months, which is also how bulk materials of Crh are normally produced (6 for bag packaged products).

column.name: PHONE_NUMBER
column.description: Phone number. Usage: if present, will be printed on the delivery note. No other usage in LOGON. SAP Origin: E1KNA1M-TELF1

column.name: VAT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
column.description: Vat registration number. Usage: if present, will be printed on the delivery note. No other usage in LOGON. SAP Origin: E1KNA1M-STCEG

column.name: TIMEZONE_CD
column.description: Timezone assigned to this business partner entity

column.name: TAX_NUMBER_1
column.description: Tax Code Number 1. Usage: If present, will be printed in the business partner listing on the cash sales invoice. No other usage in LOGON. The SAP field is KNA1-STCD1. The Idoc field is E1KNA1M-STCD1

column.name: CEM_VALID_UNTIL_DAT
column.description: Max date until all the contracts are valid within the CEM. The field is initialized by the SAP contract import once the first contract for the ship-to business partner arrives. Maintained only for business partner appearing in contracts as a ship-to

column.name: AGG_VALID_UNTIL_DAT
column.description: Max date until all the contracts are valid within the AGG. The field is initialized by the SAP contract import once the first contract for the ship-to business partner arrives. Maintained only for business partner appearing in contracts as a ship-to
